stickyNotes.content:
## Setup

This template has not been run end to end yet. Before you run it:

1. Google Drive and Google Docs connections.
2. The Illustrate a story template imported and published in the same project; replace REPLACE_WITH_ILLUSTRATOR_WORKFLOW_UUID with its workflow UUID.
3. A Google Drive folder for new stories; replace REPLACE_WITH_STORIES_FOLDER_ID.
